subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should this 13-action bundle be approved as one privileged dependency update after exact-revision review, or should the Codex, token, Docker-publishing, and CodeQL families be split for separate validation?
rationale: These revisions execute with materially different secrets and permissions, and repository policy requires direct dependency-contract review that automation and ordinary CI cannot replace.

options.title: Verify one stable bundle
options.body: Freeze a rebased head, complete exact-revision security review and affected workflow checks, then merge the bundle only if every privileged family clears.

options.title: Split privileged families
options.body: Separate Codex, token creation, Docker publication, and CodeQL updates so each security boundary can be reviewed and rolled back independently.

options.title: Pause the update
options.body: Leave the PR open or close it without merge until Dependabot repository access and head stability are restored.

recommendation.title: Verify one stable bundle
recommendation.body: Freeze a rebased head, complete exact-revision security review and affected workflow checks, then merge the bundle only if every privileged family clears.

likelyOwner.reason: Available history most strongly connects this person to the affected release and security-sensitive workflow surface.
